caseName: Penthouse International, Ltd. v. Rancho La Costa, Inc.
caseNameFull: Penthouse International, Ltd. v. Rancho La Costa, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. Cal., 2d App. Dist. Motion of Times Mirror Co. et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
